agreement.note: descriptive; clustered by system; ladder T only

conventions.energies: every energy is relative to the same structure set's own reference in the same code (Q=0 of the path, or the undisplaced supercell); absolute energies are never compared across codes
conventions.path_energy_normalisation: per modulated cell, as the screen's E(Q) maps
conventions.force_rmse: over all Cartesian components of all configs, eV/A
conventions.pbe_energy: QE '!' total energy (smeared free energy, consistent with the forces)
conventions.gt: cli._finite_t_gt: stable iff T >= spec transition_T_K
